label: Grant authenticated session and message writes subject to RLS

execute.sql: GRANT INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE public."LearningSession" TO authenticated
GRANT INSERT ON TABLE public."Message" TO authenticated

postcheck.sql:
SELECT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."LearningSession"', 'INSERT')
            AND has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."LearningSession"', 'UPDATE')
            AND has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public."Message"', 'INSERT') AS result
